items.title: Quick Ink Drying
items.description: No ink leakage even at 6 pass printing without heater on roll-to-roll inkjet printer & 90 nozzle setting on L1800 inkjet printers. Ultranex coating layer provides optimum ink absorption for rapid drying.
items.alt: DTF inkjet films ink drying comparison

items.title: Good Adhesion
items.description: Printed ink forms temporary strong adhesion to the film after sufficient heating. Critical for fine text that might otherwise peel off.
items.alt: Effective ink adhesion of DTF films

items.title: High Temperature Stability
items.description: Film remains dimensionally stable during thermo powder drying. PET film maintains stability up to 180°C for 10 minutes without losing lay-flat properties.
items.alt: High temperature stability of Ultranex DTF sheets

items.title: Colour Vibrancy
items.description: Coating opens inkjet inks to optimum levels of colour brightness. Vibrancy is influenced by coating thickness, pH value, and additives used.
items.alt: Colour vibrancy of Ultranex DTF films

items.title: Smooth Warm & Cold Peel
items.description: Labels transfer at 125°C to 170°C for 6–20 seconds with easy hot, warm, and cold peel options for maximum flexibility.
items.alt: Smooth peel process of DTF sheets

items.title: Satin Matte Finish
items.description: Even coating with minimal streaks creates a satin matte finish on transferred images — NO Repressing Required, saving time and increasing productivity.
items.alt: Ultranex DTF satin matte transfer finish

items.title: Soft Feel
items.description: Two-layer technology — release layer plus low-hardness ink receptive layer — delivers a soft, smooth feel to every transfer.
items.alt: Soft feel DTF film layer technology

items.title: Excellent Wash Fastness
items.description: The ink receptive layer acts as a scratch resistance layer, enhancing wash durability. Transfers withstand 60 to 100 washes with no cracking, fading, or peeling.

items.title: Long Shelf Life
items.description: Standard shelf life of 1 year. Printed labels on Ultranex DTF film transfer successfully even after storage for extended periods up to 1 year.
items.alt: Long shelf life of Ultranex DTF film

items.title: Trouble-Free Powder Application
items.description: Both the coating and back side have antistatic properties, preventing powder sticking issues caused by static generation in the film.

shelfLife.title: Long Shelf Life of Film & Labels
paragraphs: Ultranex DTF PET Release film has a standard shelf life of 1 year. Post 1 year, the film can still be used - we recommend testing it for printing & transfer quality, and if okay, it can be used.
Printed DTF Labels on the Ultranex DTF film can be transferred even after storage for longer periods of time. We have tested it up to 1 year and it still transfers well.

stat.label: Year Shelf Life

powderApplication.title: Trouble-Free Powder Application
paragraphs: Coating and back side of Ultranex DTF film both have antistatic properties. Mainly powder sticking issues with reference to film are due to static generation in the film.
Our advanced antistatic technology ensures smooth, trouble-free powder application every time, reducing waste and improving efficiency in your printing process.

printingGuidelines.headline: Guidelines for Printing & Transfer
printingGuidelines.subheadline: Follow these professional guidelines to achieve optimal results with Ultranex DTF Films

importantNote.title: Important Note
importantNote.body: Temperature settings should reflect the actual heat received on the film surface, not just the equipment's display temperature. Always conduct test runs to calibrate your equipment for consistent, high-quality results.

items.title: Handling & Preparation
items.content: Always wear gloves when handling the film to prevent damage to the surface. Minimize excessive tapping, as Ultranex DTF film features inherent antistatic properties that facilitate easy hot melt powder removal from non-printed areas.

items.title: Drying Process
items.content: Apply heat between 160°C to 180°C for 3-4 minutes to the printed film surface. For optimal results, use a medium-wave IR lamp heater in the shaker, as they are color-insensitive. Note: Monitor the actual temperature received on the film, not just the oven's set temperature.

items.title: Storage Recommendations
items.content: Properly dried labels should not exhibit sweating or oily residue during storage. However, it's recommended to store ready-to-use labels in moisture-proof polyethylene bags to prevent moisture-related issues and maintain quality.

items.title: Transfer Application
items.content: Apply transfers at temperatures between 160°C to 180°C for 15-30 seconds with 2-4 bars of pressure. While hot peel may not be suitable for certain designs, warm-to-cold peel is recommended for achieving the best results across all applications.

items.title: Troubleshooting
items.content: If oily stains appear on transferred labels, gently wipe the surface with a damp cloth. Re-dry remaining labels for 1-3 minutes at 160°C before transfer to remove excess moisture and prevent similar issues.

items.question: What is DTF printing?
items.answer: DTF printing means printing designs onto a special film and transferring them onto fabric using heat. It allows for crisp, full-color prints with precise details. You can use DTF printing for a variety of fabrics like cotton, polyester, twill, denim, canvas, and more.

items.question: What are the applications for Ultranex DTF transfer film roll?
items.answer: Ultranex DTF transfer release film roll is normally used to print heat transfer labels for garments, such as neck, tagless, and litho transfer labels. It has a wide range of grades for different heat transfer applications like screen printing, textile transfers, silicone transfers, and hybrid transfers.

items.question: What ink is used for the DTF printing process?
items.answer: The inks used in DTF printing are sublimation, pigment, and solvent-based. These types of ink have pigments that adhere or stick to the surface of the heat transfer film. This, in turn, gives sharp colors with a long lifespan.

items.question: What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for buying Ultranex Pet Release Film?
items.answer: MOQ starts from 5000 sheets for regular buying, but to make trial production, we will supply the required quantity.

items.question: Are there any specific care instructions for DTF prints?
items.answer: Yes. Make sure to gently wash your fabric inside out in cold water. Do not use fabric softeners and bleach on them. Air dry the garment to prevent heat damage. Also, try not to iron directly over the design. You can cover it with a cloth and use low heat.

items.question: Do ink transfers hold up the wash?
items.answer: Yes. DTF transfers can hold up between 60 to 100 washes. The designs show no signs of cracking, fading, or peeling as the transfers are rigorously tested. Moreover, cold water enhances the longevity of the designs.
